== Summary ==
[[Cindy Thornburg]], president of Decipher, Inc. Her own profile photograph on a public photo-sharing profile under the name "Cindy Thornburg" and the username "decipherpres". Uploaded unchanged (the largest size the site serves, 200 by 215 pixels).

* '''Source:''' [https://www.pinterest.com/decipherpres/ Cindy Thornburg (decipherpres)], Pinterest profile, read 27 October 2026. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027202320/https://www.pinterest.com/decipherpres/ Internet Archive]. Image: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027202344id_/https://i.pinimg.com/originals/24/f8/27/24f827d91822e8976aa0aea42f5613cf.jpg profile photo] (Wayback SHA-1 matches this file).
* '''Photographer:''' unknown (profile photo chosen by the account holder).
* '''Date:''' unknown; read 27 October 2026.
* '''Identification:''' Small World Rule. The profile name is Cindy Thornburg and the username "decipherpres" reads as "Decipher president". Cindy Thornburg is Decipher's president ([https://icv2.com/articles/games/view/15699/warren-holland-speaks-out ICv2, 25 August 2009]: "Cindy Thornburg (Decipher's President)"; preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20251203200542/https://icv2.com/articles/games/view/15699/warren-holland-speaks-out Internet Archive]). Reasoning on [[Talk:Cindy Thornburg]].

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a 200 by 215 pixel profile photograph, used only to identify the president of Decipher on her article on a non-commercial fan wiki. No free photograph of her is known, and this use cannot harm any market for the original.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/0d/Cindy_Thornburg.jpg Internet Archive item].
